locations.label: Power switch
locations.description: Open a route from the mainframe through the laboratories to the rear courtyard and turn on the switch under the catwalk. The bridge lowers, joining both sides. Locate Juggernog by checking the perk machines: the five normal machines shuffle each game. Keep points for doors before spending heavily on the box. Area shown on an original schematic; use these landmark directions for the exact interaction.

locations.label: Pack-a-Punch / mainframe
locations.description: At each of the three teleporters, start the link and return to the mainframe in spawn before the countdown expires. Interact with the mainframe to confirm it; in co-op, leave a teammate there to finish links quickly. Repeat for all three teleporter rooms. The gate in front of Pack-a-Punch lowers after the third successful link. Upgrade a normal bullet weapon for 5,000 points. Area shown on an original schematic; use these landmark directions for the exact interaction.
